logline: 사막에 불시착한 비행사 앞에, 별에서 왔다는 아이가 나타나 양을 그려 달라고 한다.
destination: 아이가 떠나온 작은 별 — 장미 한 송이가 있는 곳
protagonist: 금발이 바람에 헝클어진 예닐곱 살 아이
anchor: a small child of six or seven with wind-tousled golden hair, a long green coat and scarf
palette: desert ochre, night indigo, star silver, warm gold, pale dawn rose

prince.label: 아이
prince.desc: a small child of six or seven, wind-tousled golden hair, long green coat, a trailing yellow scarf

pilot.label: 비행사
pilot.desc: a man in his thirties in a leather flight jacket and goggles pushed up, oil on his hands

desert.label: 사막
desert.desc: an endless dune field under a huge sky, a broken biplane half buried in sand

fox.label: 여우
fox.desc: a small sand-coloured fox with oversized ears and a white-tipped tail

beats.beat: 비행사가 부서진 비행기 옆에 앉아 있다.
beats.visual: a man in a flight jacket seated against a half-buried broken biplane in endless dunes
beats.motion: sand streams steadily across the dune crest

beats.beat: 아이가 모래 언덕 위에 서 있다.
beats.visual: a small child in a long green coat standing on a dune crest against a huge empty sky
beats.motion: his yellow scarf streams steadily behind him

beats.visual: a child holding out a sheet of paper to a seated pilot, both small against the dunes
beats.motion: the paper trembles steadily in the wind between them

beats.visual: a pilot's oil-stained hand drawing a simple box on paper, pencil held loosely
beats.motion: the pencil moves steadily along the paper

beats.beat: 아이가 모래 위에서 여우와 마주 앉는다.
beats.visual: a child in a green coat sitting facing a small sand-coloured fox among low dunes
beats.motion: the fox's ears turn steadily toward the child

beats.visual: a small child lying back on cooling sand looking up at a sky thick with stars
a small child in a green coat walking away across moonlit sand toward a low rock
beats.motion: his scarf trails steadily behind him

beats.visual: a line of small footprints across pale dawn sand, a broken biplane far behind
beats.motion: wind smooths the footprints steadily away

withheld: 아이가 제 별로 돌아가는 방법과, 비행사가 그 뒤에 알게 되는 것
